definition_en: The ability to comprehend written information, communicate clearly through writing, and apply mathematical reasoning to solve problems.
definition_ms: Keupayaan untuk memahami maklumat bertulis, berkomunikasi dengan jelas melalui penulisan, serta menggunakan penaakulan matematik bagi menyelesaikan masalah.
typical_tasks_en:
• Summarise the key points from a 20-page contract for the manager.
• Write a clear incident report after a workplace accident.
• Calculate the discount and final price for a bulk order.
typical_tasks_ms:
• Ringkaskan perkara utama daripada kontrak 20 halaman untuk pengurus.
• Tulis laporan insiden yang jelas selepas kemalangan di tempat kerja.
• Kira diskaun dan harga akhir untuk pesanan pukal.
inclusion_rules:
• The task requires comprehending complex written documents
• The task involves producing clear, structured written communication
• The task requires performing calculations or mathematical reasoning
• The task involves interpreting numerical data or statistics
• The task requires using literacy or numeracy for decision-making
exclusion_rules:
• The task involves only copying text without comprehension
• The user performs simple arithmetic with a calculator without reasoning
• The task requires no reading, writing, or calculation
• The user is only filling in templates without original composition
insufficient_context_rule: Return insufficient_context=true when the task copies text or enters numbers without comprehension, composition, or reasoning.

confusions.boundary_rule: Reading/writing/math are foundational skills. Analytical thinking is higher-level reasoning.
confusions.example_task: Read the report, calculate the variance, and explain what it means.
confusions.expected_labels: Reading, writing and mathematics; Analytical thinking

confusions.boundary_rule: Reading/writing is about literacy. Multi-lingualism is about multiple languages.
confusions.example_task: Write a clear memo in English.

confusions.boundary_rule: Reading/writing are cognitive. Technological literacy is digital.
confusions.example_task: Type the meeting minutes using the word processor.
confusions.expected_labels: Reading, writing and mathematics; Technological literacy

examples.task_text: Summarise the key points from a 20-page contract for the manager.
